name: CJ Logistics - Wilmer TX (Southport Logistics Park)

fieldNotes.truckGate: CJ's own facility sheet explicitly describes Wilmer as a 'gated lot with a Welcome Center.' Truck yard is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (confirmed in Street View 2026-02 along E Fulghum Rd); the access driveway off Fulghum Rd is the controlled truck entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: The 'Welcome Center' is a staffed driver check-in facility at the gated truck entrance - functions as the guard shack. Check-in lane with chevron markings visible near the NW entry in zoom-20 satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Southport Logistics Park Building 1 - 1.1M sq ft with 141 dock doors per CJ's facility sheet. Satellite confirms continuous dock-door banks with trailers backed in on BOTH long building faces - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate long building faces.
fieldNotes.dropYard: 310 yard spots per CJ's facility sheet; satellite shows extensive trailer drop yards on both sides of the building with 200+ parked trailers - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry apron and large truck courts provide ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southport Logistics Park, Wilmer TX - edge-of-town logistics park south of Dallas, surrounded by undeveloped land and an older industrial yard; rural setting.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; facility is 0.5 miles from the nearest intermodal yard but not directly rail-served.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound lanes at the gated entry; not precisely resolvable.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; left in uncertainFields.
